question: After the main-thread highlighter is repaired, should ClickClack core own all six proposed attachment preview formats?
rationale: The PR expands permanent browser parser, dependency, sandbox, and support boundaries beyond the existing PDF/text preview cards, so code correctness alone cannot establish product acceptance.

options.title: Ship a narrow initial viewer
options.body: Land inert source, Markdown, and existing PDF support first, with DOCX and uploaded HTML reviewed in focused follow-ups.

options.title: Accept the full viewer
options.body: Own all six formats after the availability defect is repaired and focused compatibility validation passes.

options.title: Keep hardened downloads
options.body: Decline the added browser parsing surface and retain the current download-oriented attachment model.

recommendation.title: Ship a narrow initial viewer
recommendation.body: Land inert source, Markdown, and existing PDF support first, with DOCX and uploaded HTML reviewed in focused follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: The current attachment renderer, upload helper, and upload documentation trace to this person's v0.1.0 release commit.
